data.one_liner: Generate Mermaid dependency diagrams and detect cycles in every source code folder.
data.what_it_does: LayerLens operates on file system concepts to generate a Mermaid flowchart dependency diagram inside every directory of a Dart or Flutter package. It also identifies and alerts you to any cyclic dependencies or changed diagrams.
use_when: You want to visualize file and directory level dependencies within your Dart or Flutter project.
You need to detect cyclic dependencies and enforce architectural rules in CI/CD pipelines.
You want automatic DEPS.md documentation generated for every folder in your source code.
avoid_when: You need to visualize cross-package dependencies rather than inside-package ones.
You are using a programming language other than Dart.
strengths: Operates on file system concepts reflecting mental models of the project.
Detects cyclic dependencies and supports CI/CD failure flags.
Supports multiple layout engines like dagre and elk.
weaknesses: Requires manual preview tools or extensions in IDEs to render Mermaid diagrams.
data.setup_notes: Can be activated globally via pub or added as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml and run via dart run layerlens.
